title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Charges Entry — Agent-Assisted Phone Payment Fee
content:
**Charge.** On a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account, the agent-assisted fee for a payment is the plan's phone payment fee, charged as a flat amount and rounded to the cent. The payment named is the most recent payment taken through a phone agent; when that payment already carries its phone payment fee, nothing more is charged.

Every amount rounded to the cent goes to the nearest cent, and an exact half cent rounds up. The plan's phone payment fee is the plan's own figure for a payment made through a phone agent.

## Entry at a glance

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Which payment the fee names | The most recent payment on the account taken through a phone agent |
| The fee | The plan's phone payment fee, as a flat amount, rounded to the cent |
| That payment already carries a phone payment fee | Nothing more is charged |

## Hypothetical illustrations (figures are not plan fees)

- A plan whose phone payment fee is 8.00; the most recent phone-agent payment carries no fee yet: the fee is 8.00.
- The same account after that payment's fee entry has been booked: nothing more is charged for that payment.
- An account whose most recent payment through a phone agent was taken in March, followed by an online portal payment in April: the payment named is the March phone-agent payment.
